content: According to current scientific understanding, the age of the universe is approximately 13.8 billion years old. This estimate is based on precise measurements from multiple sources, including cosmic microwave background radiation observations from satellites like the Planck space telescope, and studies of the oldest known stars. The Big Bang theory, supported by extensive scientific evidence, suggests the universe began expanding from an extremely hot and dense state around this time.
